description: Canonical token values for the editorial design system. Values are taken from the JSX source (canonical); see notes for derivations.

contrast_pairs.note: 'File Reply ->' sits on the Paper Subtle composer.

color.surface_selected.note: JSX 'Paper Subtle' #F1ECDF — selected rows and the reply composer.

color.surface_inverse.note: Editorial never inverts in the JSX; the inverse pair is ink as fill with paper text.

color.text_placeholder.note: Live CSS: placeholder is text_primary at opacity 0.5.

color.accent_foreground.note: Burgundy is used as type and rules in the JSX, never as a fill; paper is the legible foreground.

color.action.note: 'File Reply ->' is burgundy uppercase Inter text.

color.danger.note: JSX 'Masthead Deep' #6B1623 — keeps destructive states in the burgundy family, distinct from the masthead accent.

color.success.note: No status hues in the JSX. Deep ink-green chosen to sit with the paper/ink palette (6.9:1 with paper text).

color.warning.note: No status hues in the JSX. Ochre ink (5.4:1 with paper text).

color.info.note: No status hues in the JSX. Ink-blue (8.3:1 with paper text).

color.border_input.note: Search input is underlined with a 1px #D8CEB9 rule.

color.focus_ring.note: JSX selection model: 'Focus outline 2px solid #8B1E2D offset 2px'.

radius.chrome.note: JSX: radius 4 is 'Spec chrome' (the showcase panels); the app shell itself is 0.

font.mono.note: Editorial has no monospace family; code falls back to the Inter metadata face.

type.body.note: JSX 'body-lg' 15px — AI message body, the primary reading text. 13px italic replies are extras.type.reply.

space.md.note: Not named in JSX; 16px/24px are the recurring sidebar/main gutters.

motion.fast.note: JSX .snd 'File Reply →': 'transition: opacity 0.15s' (CSS default ease); selection spec row 'Transition 150ms ease'. exit_ms is derived (~0.7 x enter, the fine-design ratio): the JSX has no exit animations; React unmounts instantly.

motion.moderate.note: JSX .ci list rows: 'fadeSlideUp 0.35s ease-out', 8px travel, 60ms stagger. exit_ms is derived (~0.7 x enter, the fine-design ratio): the JSX has no exit animations; React unmounts instantly.

motion.slow.note: JSX .mi messages: 'fadeSlideUp 0.45s ease-out', 8px travel, 100ms stagger (doc row: 450ms ease-out, 100ms stagger). exit_ms is derived (~0.7 x enter, the fine-design ratio): the JSX has no exit animations; React unmounts instantly.

motion.expressive.note: No expressive motion in the JSX. One step beyond slow on the same ease-out curve, no spring: Editorial's register is calm print.

motion.reduced_motion.note: The JSX has no prefers-reduced-motion query: every animation (including the staggered entrances) plays regardless of the user setting. Reduced motion keeps the gentle opacity entrances and drops the 8px travel.
